title: Personality Driven Development: Exploring the Frontier of Agents with Attitude
talk_summary: A product/branding talk about giving AI agents anthropomorphic forms and personalities (avatars, names, roles) at a company called Perpetual, framed as 'personality-driven development'. It covers why personas help comprehension, decomposition, and price anchoring, plus downsides like inclusivity issues, inflated performance expectations, and job-replacement anxiety.

takeaways.what_they_do: They use human role names (AI engineer, AI recruiter, AI copywriter) as the abstraction boundary for splitting agent responsibilities, which they say maps naturally to specialized agents with a finite tool set and fewer inputs.
Agent behavior and preferences are injected entirely via prompts rather than config checkboxes, making each instance bespoke per customer.
